spokenMeaning: Commit to one direction and hold it despite pressure from every side.
viewerTakeaway: The audience keeps rotating its asks and its applause; your bearing never rotates with it.

visualNarrative.action: Headline 'PICK ONE / AND HOLD IT' staggers in on the right half from a 14px right offset, lines 0.25s apart, 'HOLD' the only gold word.
visualNarrative.meaning: The imperative is stated once, before the crowd noise begins.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Left-aligned 96px uppercase block confined to the right half, one accent word, clear of the left object field.

visualNarrative.action: In the left field a faint dial ring draws itself around a center point, its rim studded with small dim tick-arrows all pointing different ways.
visualNarrative.meaning: Everyone's asks: many directions offered, none of them yours.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One muted circular ring at x=30%, several small dim arrowheads on its rim, no gold anywhere yet.

visualNarrative.action: The ring begins to rotate; as each tick-arrow passes the top, a short label flickers ('MATCH', 'CHANGE', 'PLEASE') and the rim arrows pulse like applause marks.
visualNarrative.meaning: The audience keeps re-asking and applauding for a reshaped answer.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Rotating ring with dim arc-pulses on the rim, three muted 34px labels swapping in sequence, all secondary grey.

visualNarrative.action: A single gold bearing needle snaps outward from the center on one fixed heading, locking there while the ring keeps turning behind it.
visualNarrative.meaning: You choose one direction — and it does not turn with the room.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: One straight gold needle from dial center to a fixed bearing, ring visibly mid-rotation behind it, gold restricted to needle and one heading tick.

visualNarrative.action: The ring accelerates a full turn, arrows and applause pulses sweep past the needle; the needle never deflects by a frame, and the label 'ONE BEARING' fades in at its tip.
visualNarrative.meaning: Confirmation: pressure is cyclical, the stance is not — everyone keeps clapping, you keep your heading.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Needle pixel-identical through the sweep, one 34px muted label at the needle tip, no second accent color.

visualNarrative.action: Ring, arrows and applause pulses dissolve; a soft restrained glow settles along the needle, the caption fades in bottom-right, and the frame holds perfectly static.
visualNarrative.meaning: Resolve: once the noise is gone, only your direction remains in the frame.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Single gold needle on an empty dark field, one complete caption on its own baseline, absolute stillness.

motionBeats.action: Headline lines stagger in from a 14px right offset with fade, 0.25s apart.
motionBeats.purpose: States the imperative fast so the dial event keeps visual priority.

motionBeats.action: Ring draws via a masked circular reveal; rim tick-arrows stagger on one by one.
motionBeats.purpose: Builds the field of competing asks before any of them move.

motionBeats.action: Ring rotates with measured ease-in-out; labels and applause arcs highlight in sequence at the top position.
motionBeats.purpose: Shows the audience actively re-asking and clapping for a reshaped answer.

motionBeats.action: Needle scales from 0.2 to full length with a crisp ease-out and holds absolutely still through the continuing rotation.
motionBeats.purpose: Makes commitment visible as a locked heading amid moving noise.

motionBeats.action: Ring completes an accelerated sweep, then rim arrows and pulses dissolve; 'ONE BEARING' label fades in.
motionBeats.purpose: Confirms the stance is direction-independent of the pressure.

motionBeats.action: Restrained glow settles along the needle, caption fades in, everything holds static.

compositionIntent: Right text-left object: headline, subheadline and caption form one left-aligned block on the right half; the dial ring anchors x=30% in the left field with the gold needle pointing left-down on a fixed heading. Roughly 65% empty dark field; the rotating rim never crosses into the text zone. Gold appears only on the needle, its heading tick and the word HOLD.
visualEvidence: One gold bearing needle held pixel-still while the rim of asks completes a full rotation behind it.
Rim tick-arrows and applause pulses sweeping past without deflecting the needle by a frame.
A muted label at the needle tip naming the proof, appearing only after the sweep finishes.
One complete caption sentence with no truncation, overprint, or text collision.
A single accent color (gold) against muted secondary ring, arrows and text.
forbiddenInterpretations: A detached glow dot, floating axis fragment or stray marker with no structural role.
Duplicate or ghosted text bleeding behind the subheadline or label.
Pressure arrows crossing over the text block or pinning the needle off-heading in the final frame.
A second accent color anywhere, truncated caption fragments, or red warning treatment.
Generic force diagrams with grids, numeric readouts, or gratuitous glow bloom.
noveltyIntent: Unlike the earlier plumb-rebound, the payoff here is non-motion: a dial of everyone's asks and applause rotates a full circle while one gold needle simply refuses to turn — commitment proven as held heading amid cyclical noise, not as swing-and-return.
